div.head: Paper Prepared in the Policy Planning Staff
div.p: MID-TERM PLANNING EXERCISE SUMMARY OF INFORMATION ON U.S. FOREIGN POLICY

list.label: a.
list.item: Reassert US leadership and recapture global credibility.
list.label: b.
list.item: Restore American military strength and take command of peace issue.
list.label: c.
list.item: Counter adventurism by USSR and its proxies.
list.label: d.
list.item: Strengthen Atlantic and Pacific alliances and friendships with key Third World countries.
list.label: e.
list.item: Bolster international (especially Western) cooperation on world economic problems.
list.label: f.
list.item: Conclude peaceful settlements in Mideast and southern Africa.

list.label: a.
list.item: Strengthening US defense posture and international leadership.
list.label: b.
list.item: Proposed comprehensive arms control program concerning START, INF and MBFR, generating Allied support for US security policies.
list.label: c.
list.item: Established multinational forces, facilitating Israeli withdrawal from Sinai and PLO withdrawal from Beirut, and Israeli departure from Beirut.
list.label: d.
list.item: Presented dramatic Reagan peace plan for Mideast.
list.label: e.
list.item: Achieved progress toward Namibia settlement.
list.label: f.
list.item: Fostered free elections in El Salvador and stymied guerrilla takeover there.
list.label: g.
list.item: Diplomatic resolution of Taiwan arms issue.

list.label: a.
list.item: Sustain congressional/public support for strengthening the US defense posture.
list.label: b.
list.item: Maintain support for US arms control program, thereby facilitating INF deployments and Western conventional defense improvements.
list.label: c.
list.item: Strengthen Atlantic alliance and NATO solidarity, and seek resolution of pipeline dispute in a way that meets President’s objectives.
list.label: d.
list.item: Press ahead on Reagan Mideast proposals and on withdrawal of all foreign forces from Lebanon.
list.label: e.
list.item: Conclude Namibia agreement involving Cuban withdrawal from Angola.
list.label: f.
list.item: Counter Soviet/proxy adventurism in Central America and regional hot spots.
list.label: g.
list.item: Strengthen international cooperation on world economic problems, including global debt and trade issues.
list.label: h.
list.item: Build support for our nuclear non-proliferation policy, which emphasizes strengthened international safeguards and which focuses on countries and regions of real proliferation risk.
